      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;

      position: relative;
    }
    .pane + .pane {
      border-left: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
    }
    .book {
      font-weight: 700;

      column-gap: 3px;

      padding: 10px 9px;

      min-height: 57px;
